Move beyond static integrations by orchestrating autonomous AI agents and complex workflows on a fair-code, self-hostable canvas with native tool use. 🚀

Are you tired of writing thousands of lines of boilerplate code just to connect LLMs to your SaaS tools, handle API retries, and manage state? Bridging disparate software systems and modern AI models shouldn't require building a custom orchestration layer from scratch. 

n8n is a hybrid visual-and-code automation platform that lets developers build, orchestrate, and self-host multi-step workflows. It combines traditional API integrations with autonomous AI agents and custom logic, all while preventing vendor lock-in and keeping your data strictly under your control.

🔥 Key Features Built for Engineers:
• AI-Native Orchestration: Build multi-step AI agents and workflows with native support for LLMs, tool usage, human-in-the-loop approvals, and full observability.
• Model Flexibility: Connect seamlessly to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or local open-source models for architecture-agnostic switching.
• Extensible Hybrid Coding: Combine a visual node-based canvas with custom JavaScript, Python, and npm packages for deep data transformations.
• Massive Integration Ecosystem: Access 1500+ native integrations and 9000+ templates to quickly tie AI into your existing enterprise databases, SaaS, and internal APIs.

Whether you are spinning up autonomous customer support agents that query vector DBs or orchestrating heavy data pipelines, n8n handles the heavy lifting so you only write code where it actually matters. 

Check out the repo, star it, and start building your next agentic workflow today:
https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n

Stop wasting time hunting for the right AI art references across slow, foreign-language sites! 🛑

Introducing ai-pose-gallery-zh: A zero-dependency, fully localized 1439-image AI pose reference gallery designed for lightning-fast visual asset sourcing and instant Cloudflare Pages deployment. 🚀

🔥 The Problem Solved:
AI artists and prompt engineers often struggle with inaccessible or poorly organized reference material. This project mirrors and fully localizes a massive database of 1,439 human pose reference images spanning 288 groups and 5 camera angles into a blisteringly fast, responsive static web gallery. 

✨ Key Features:
• Complete localization of 1,439 records across 4 systems and 26 categories, complete with keyboard shortcuts and instant search.
• Zero-dependency vanilla frontend featuring multi-angle thumbnail switching, grouped card views, responsive image lightbox navigation, and optimized lazy loading.
• Robust Python asset pipeline supporting concurrent downloading with resume functionality, automated translation mapping, and integrity verification.
• Production-ready Cloudflare Pages config with 1-year asset caching, built-in SEO, JSON-LD schema, and sitemap integration.

💡 Why Developers Love It:
Use this repo as a turnkey blueprint for building localized, high-performance static asset galleries. It offers clean, framework-free patterns for filtering large JSON datasets client-side and deploying bulletproof static sites on edge networks.

🔗 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/anhao/ai-pose-gallery-zh

Running stock, unmodified macOS on non-Apple ARM hardware just went from "impossible" to reality. 🤯

For years, systems engineers and virtualization enthusiasts have stared at the brick wall of running Apple Silicon-targeted operating systems on alternative ARM architectures. The mismatch in platform contracts, memory page tables, and proprietary hardware components made native virtualization a pipe dream.

Until now. 

Meet Snapintosh: an extraordinary engineering feat that boots stock macOS on Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Elite hardware. It functions as a custom EL2 monitor and hypervisor, bridging the gap between Apple's proprietary demands and non-Apple silicon.

Here is what makes this repository a masterclass in low-level systems architecture:

🔹 Custom EL2 Hypervisor: Runs unmodified Apple kernelcache binaries (J700/T8140 kernel) by emulating SPTM/TXM monitor calls and Apple device models.
🔹 Shadow Page-Table Walker: Seamlessly translates the kernel's 16 KiB guest page tables to 4 KiB hardware shadow tables.
🔹 Custom GPU Driver Stack: Features an AdrenoMetal plugin, an AdrenoX2 IOGPU kernel extension, and an air2ir3 compiler that translates Apple IR (AIR) directly to Mesa ir3.
🔹 Bare-Metal Integration: Includes I2C-HID keyboard/touchpad drivers, QCC2072 Wi-Fi work, and NVMe storage routed through an emulated Apple storage controller.

Whether you are working on bare-metal hypervisors, architecture translation, custom shader compilers, or platform bring-up, studying this codebase will level up your systems engineering game.

Dive into the code and explore the implementation today:
https://github.com/Snapintosh/Snapintosh

Juggle multiple AI coding assistants? agent-purge unifies your custom system prompts and personas across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and more with zero friction and total reversibility. 🤖⚡️

Every AI coding tool reads system prompts differently—through CLI flags, config files, or runtime patches. Managing this fragmentation across your daily workflow is a massive headache. 

agent-purge solves this by unifying all entry points into a single Markdown-based persona system. Write your custom instructions once and enforce them globally across your entire tech stack. 

🔥 Key Features:
• Multi-channel injection: Permanent installation, PATH shims for raw commands, and in-session hot-swapping via slash commands
• Comprehensive coverage: Works seamlessly across Claude Code, Codex, Grok, OpenCode, and more
• Magpie gateway plugin: Intercepts requests locally to rewrite system prompts on the fly without touching individual harnesses
• Fully reversible: Zero-dependency architecture stored in your local home directory, letting you restore original configs down to the exact byte

🛠️ Perfect for: Enforcing strict coding style guides, language constraints, and security rules universally, or instantly toggling between architectural, debugging, and refactoring personas without restarting your environment.

Stop wasting time rewriting context for every separate tool. Establish a single source of truth for your AI personas today!

👇 Check it out on GitHub:
https://github.com/ZiChuanLan/agent-purge

🚀 Ever wondered how to pack an entire interactive 3D physics, chemistry, and biology lab into a single 1 MB HTML file? 

Meet Tongjiang Lab—a brilliant open-source platform that transforms browser-based 3D graphics into 54 self-contained interactive science simulations built using WebGL and Three.js. 

💡 The Problem It Solves:
Building rich educational tech usually means wrestling with complex backend deployments, heavy asset loaders, and poor offline performance. Tongjiang Lab eliminates this friction by bundling 3D rendering logic, interactive UI consoles, and step-by-step guides into completely portable, single-file HTML files that run anywhere with zero external dependencies.

✨ Key Features:
• Single-File Architecture: Bundles 3D logic, UI consoles, and instruction paths into ~1 MB portable files.
• High-Performance WebGL: Leverages Three.js to render smooth, complex molecular structures, chemical processes, and physics experiments.
• Classroom-Ready: Includes built-in live control consoles and step guides designed for interactive whiteboards and projectors.
• Machine-Readable Metadata: A comprehensive catalog.json maps every lesson directly to curriculum standards and textbook locations.

🛠️ Why Developers & EdTech Engineers Love It:
Study this repository to master the architectural pattern of packing complex Three.js apps into lightweight, single-file bundles without bloated build pipelines. It is the ultimate blueprint for offline-first educational tools and seamless iframe embedding.

🔗 Explore the repository and drop a star:
https://github.com/smithjohn78390/tongjiang-lab
